# Are all algebraic HT tails generated by Manin and log-parallel factors?

- **ID:** albanese-orbifold-completeness-of-algebraic-ht-tails
- **Stage:** 1-in-progress
- **Type:** CONJECTURE
- **Source:** rational orbifold classification + Manin horizon + toric counterexample repair
- **Statement:** For a broad geometric class of finite surjective self-maps, every nonconstant
  stable differential-tail observable should arise from a maximal semiabelian/Manin quotient, a
  log-parallel factor carrying a flat logarithmic tensor, or a reversible automorphic factor.

## Goal

Prove a converse to the constructed examples.  This is the current medal-level open core: turn
the observed group/orbifold mechanism from a sufficient source of tails into a classification of
all sources.

## Gates

- [x] 0 -> 1 in-progress: source-pure statement, positive direction, collision boundary, and
  counterexample search specified
- [ ] 1 -> 2 fully-proven: no hidden differential-groupoid factor remains
- [ ] 2 -> 3 formalized: theorem statement and decisive reductions in Lean
- [ ] 3 -> 4 publication-ready: external expert validation and independent applications

## Candidate scope

Let `(K,delta)` be differentially closed of characteristic zero.  Let `X/K` be a normal
projective `Q`-factorial klt variety and let `f:X->X` be a finite int-amplified endomorphism.
Let `K<X>` be the differential rational function field of a differential-generic point and

`Tail(f)=intersection_n f^(n*)K<X>`.

The scope is chosen because equivariant minimal-model and Albanese structure theorems exist for
int-amplified endomorphisms.  It may need narrowing to smooth varieties or widening to finite
quasi-etale covers.

## Conjectural theorem

After replacing `f` by an iterate and passing to a finite quasi-etale cover, there should be a
maximal equivariant factor

`pi:X --> S`

whose building blocks, possibly visible only after an equivariant birational logarithmic
compactification, are:

1. abelian or semiabelian isogeny factors, with tail generated by their Manin maps;
2. log-parallel or log-Calabi--Yau factors carrying flat logarithmic currents or tensors;
3. degree-one automorphic factors, whose positions persist reversibly.

The proposed equality is

`Tail(f)=pi^*Tail(f_S).`                                           (1)

In particular, if no such positive-dimensional factor exists, `Tail(f)=K`.

## What is already proved

### Dimension one

- On `P^1`, a degree-at-least-two rational map has nonconstant tail exactly in the
  power/Chebyshev/Lattes cases, and the tail is its minimal parabolic-orbifold current.
- On a genus-one curve, isogeny tails are Manin/Maurer--Cartan tails.
- A curve of genus at least two admits no finite self-map of degree greater than one.

Thus the conjecture is complete in dimension one.

### Abelian varieties in every dimension

The multiplication tail equals the Manin quotient, and pure constant isogeny tails are
Maurer--Cartan invariant fields.  Embedded tail stabilizers recover the Manin kernel.

### Toric varieties in every dimension

For a smooth complete toric pair `(X,D)` and a finite toric endomorphism extending a torus
isogeny, the tail is exactly the dense-torus tail.  Pure multiplication has

`Tail=C<dlog chi_1,...,dlog chi_r>`.

Thus every order-zero position is erased while full differential rank survives in the trivial
log-cotangent frame `Omega^1_X(log D)`.  This theorem is the counterexample that forced the
present log-pair formulation: a projective toric variety need not admit a projective semiabelian
quotient carrying this tail.

### Positive direction for arbitrary factors

If `pi:X->Y` is equivariant, stable-core functoriality proves

`pi^*Tail(f_Y) subset Tail(f).`                                    (2)

The exact field-theoretic statement is Lean-formalized as
`map_stableRangeCore_le_of_intertwine`.

### Converse for a full first-order tail coframe

Suppose the tail contains the evaluations of a generically full rational coframe whose span is
preserved invertibly by pullback.  Wedge the coframe to obtain a rational eigenvolume `Omega`.
The ramification order law

`ord_E(Omega)+1=e_E(ord_(f(E))(Omega)+1)`

forces every periodic divisorial singularity to have order `-1`.  Consequently

`div(Omega)=-D`, `K_X+D~0`, `f^(-1)D=D`,

and `f` is etale off the reduced boundary `D`.  For polarized maps, the log-Calabi--Yau
classification then gives a finite quotient of a toric log-Calabi--Yau fibration over an abelian
variety after the required modification.  Thus the repaired converse is proved for full-rank
first-order linear tails.

### Eigen-plurivolume bridge

More generally, any rational eigen-`k`-canonical density `Theta` canonically defines

`Delta_Theta=-(1/k)div(Theta)`

with `K_X+Delta_Theta~_Q 0` and exact log-crepant pullback.  Its coefficients obey

`1-d_E=e_E(1-d_(f(E)))`,

so every periodic ramified component has coefficient one.  This includes finite-holonomy
orbifold bookkeeping.  It does not by itself make `Delta_Theta` effective or log canonical.

## Structural literature boundary

Meng--Zhang develop equivariant MMP and structural constraints for polarized and int-amplified
endomorphisms: <https://arxiv.org/abs/1806.07747>.  Yoshikawa proves that after a quasi-etale
cover an int-amplified klt variety is of Fano type over its Albanese variety:
<https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.01257>.  These results make an Albanese-plus-rationally-connected
reduction plausible but do not classify differential stable tails.  The toric theorem shows that
the fibre analysis must retain a boundary divisor and logarithmic cotangent geometry; the
projective variety alone forgets the relevant factor.

Moraga--Yanez--Yeong prove that a polarized log-Calabi--Yau pair becomes a finite quotient of a
toric log-Calabi--Yau fibration over an abelian variety after the prescribed modification:
<https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.18092>.  Combined with the stable-coframe eigenvolume theorem, this
closes the full-rank first-order case.  It does not extract a log-Calabi--Yau boundary from an
arbitrary higher-order tail.

## Counterexample audit required before promotion

The conjecture must be killed or repaired against:

- non-toric log Calabi--Yau and log-Fano pairs;
- toroidal embeddings which are not globally toric;
- products where only one factor has a tail;
- projective cones over elliptic curves;
- quasi-etale quotients and nontrivial finite holonomy;
- invariant foliations/webs not arising from algebraic-group quotients;
- rationally connected/Fano endomorphisms with hidden differential invariants;
- nonautonomous phase-dependent orbifolds;
- singular varieties where jets and quasi-etale descent misbehave.

The toric test retired the original formulation based only on projective semiabelian and
one-dimensional orbifold factors.  Any example with a nonconstant tail and no factor of the
repaired types (1)--(3) retires this formulation as well.

## Proposed attack

1. Use an equivariant log MMP to split the quasi-abelian/Albanese base from log-Fano-type fibres,
   retaining the ramification and boundary divisor.
2. Apply Manin-horizon completeness on the abelian base.
3. Extract from a minimal-order nonconstant tail observable either a rational stable coframe, an
   eigen-plurivolume, or a lower-rank invariant foliation/tensor on a factor; then prove the
   resulting rational boundary is effective and log canonical.
4. Show differential-tail formation descends and ascends through the finite quasi-etale cover.
5. Rule out residual mixed invariants by a relative differential-Luroth/groupoid argument.

Step 3 is the present open core.  Once a full first-order coframe exists, the eigenvolume theorem
already forces log-parallel geometry.  What remains is the higher-order symbol-extraction
problem: a minimal tail observable need not be linear in velocity, need not have full rank, and
may define only a foliation or web.  Even an extracted eigen-plurivolume gives a rational
log-crepant boundary whose effectivity is not automatic.  This is not solved by the one-dimensional Casale
classification, the toric calculation, or the log-Calabi--Yau structure theorem.

## Physical/topological interpretation

If (1) holds, every persistent source-pure observable of an expanding algebraic geometry would be
a generalized velocity or flat logarithmic tensor on a hidden special factor.  Generic
log-Fano/rationally connected bulk information would be completely erased.  The physical picture
would then be exact: the tail is a static boundary algebra on the logarithmic compactification,
not a propagated state in a bulk flow.

## RH impact audit

A proof would sharply constrain any algebraic-geometric RH mechanism: a persistent tail would
have to come from an explicit Manin/semiabelian, log-parallel, or automorphic factor.  The toric
repair warns that absence of a projective group quotient is not enough for a no-go result; one
must also rule out a logarithmic open stratum and its character lattice.  The completed-zeta
source currently has no such proven factor, so the conjecture neither proves RH nor supplies one.
It would mainly be a powerful no-go/classification tool.
